transport.framing: one JSON-RPC 2.0 object per LF-terminated line
transport.requestId: JSON scalar or null; responses preserve the request id
transport.notifications: Requests without id do not receive a response
transport.stdoutBackpressure: bounded; helper may terminate rather than block indefinitely

invariants: protocol equals maka.cu.windows/0
generation is unique per helper process
distributionReady remains false for the comparison prototype
capture.targetWindowWgc is true and capture.screenRect is false
observe requires an explicitly supplied HWND
windowGeneration is a 16-character hexadecimal fingerprint
tokens are opaque and scoped to one snapshot
no title, foreground, coordinate, SendInput, PostMessage, or global pointer selection

actionSemantics.click_element: Invoke, SelectionItem, or Toggle semantic pattern
actionSemantics.scroll: Exactly one ScrollPattern.Scroll on the token's own container, plus bounded same-identity Current percent readback in the requested direction; no ScrollItem fallback

scrollReadback.verified: finite percentage in [0,100] changes in requested direction within budget on the same verified target
scrollReadback.unknown: timeout, cancellation, wrong direction, invalid percent, lost axis, read or identity failure, or provider error after dispatch

invariants: snapshot is spent for every accepted action attempt before provider mutation
HWND, PID, process start time, window generation and RuntimeId are revalidated
duplicate or cross-snapshot tokens fail closed
set_value uses ValuePattern and readback; click/select/toggle/scroll use only their matching UIA semantic patterns
scroll requires the exact token's own ScrollPattern; ScrollItem.ScrollIntoView is not directional scroll and is never a fallback
press_enter has no implicit keyboard fallback; compatibility ops require a separately minted one-shot authorization
unknown never claims verified
authorization is minted only for a live, revalidated snapshot and exact RuntimeId
authorization is opaque, process-local, one-shot, expires within 5 seconds and is consumed before focus/input
authorization is bound to exact HWND/PID/process start/window generation/helper generation/op/payload
missing, reused, cross-snapshot, cross-window, overlong/control payload or op confusion fails closed
capture uses IGraphicsCaptureItemInterop.CreateForWindow(HWND)
readback uses D3D11 staging texture
capture is tied to the observed windowGeneration
no GDI, desktop screenshot, screen rectangle, or covering-pixel fallback
cancel acknowledgement never replaces the original request response
before dispatch act returns refused/cancelled_before_dispatch and spends snapshot
after dispatch operation is not falsely reported as undone; original request settles actual/unknown
provider-blocked cancellation remains responsive; supervisor owns force-kill after 2000ms
returns within shutdownGrace
does not wait indefinitely for blocked provider

lifecycle.snapshotRegistry: in-memory and invalid after process termination
lifecycle.parentDeath: stdin EOF or parent pipe closure must not leave an orphan indefinitely
lifecycle.supervisor: force-kills a provider-blocked helper after cancelGrace and starts a fresh generation
